name: Delta-6 system defense starfighter
description: The Delta-6 system defense starfighter, also known more simply as the Delta-6 starfighter was a model of venerable starfighter with aerospace superiority capabilities. It had a long, narrow, arrowhead-shaped fuselage with two light laser cannons mounted forward and a small, cramped, bubble-canopied cockpit mounted far aft over the engine.
